english.value: English proficiency is required: IELTS 6.5, TOEFL iBT 80 (4.5 for tests after January 2026), or DET 115. Scores must remain valid within two years. Exemptions may cover two consecutive full-time study years in the US/an English-only official-language country, four secondary years at an American-accredited English-medium school abroad, or official AP English Language 4+, IB English Language and Literature 5+, or A/AS English C+. Predicted scores and English-medium instruction alone do not qualify.

evidence.quote: TOEFL (iBT): Overall score of 80 or 4.5 for tests taken after January 2026

deadline.value: International first-year deadlines: binding ED and nonbinding EA I November 1; EA II December 1; RD January 15. Later applications are considered on a space-available rolling basis. Supporting documents, including arts submissions, must meet the applicable deadline. The source does not label an entry year; reconfirm dates before submitting.

aid.value: International applicants are automatically considered for merit scholarships and need-based assistance after completing their application. Full scholarships are unavailable; a personal contribution is required. Submit Lawrence's own Certification of Finance and supporting documents within five days of the admission deadline; CSS Profile cannot replace it. Awards renew at the same level subject to the published terms.

english.value: Proficiency evidence is required. Accepted thresholds include IELTS 6.5, DET 115, TOEFL iBT 80 before January 21, 2026 or 4.0 thereafter, SAT EBRW 580, or ACT English/Writing 24. English as the primary language or school-official confirmation of English-medium high school can establish proficiency. Test agencies must send scores directly; student/counselor copies are not accepted.

evidence.quote: IELTS 6.5 out of 9 overall band score

fee.value: No application fee for international applicants.

evidence.quote: does not charge an application fee

deadline.value: First-year fall applications: ED November 1, EA December 1, ED II and RD January 15; later applications are also accepted. Certification of Finance is due within five days of the application deadline. The page is not entry-year labelled. Conservatory applicants need an audition and separate round guidance; do not infer their eligibility from this general schedule.

english.value: Non-native English speakers must document proficiency for the I-20/F-1 process. The international page lists required/recommended scores: IELTS 6.0/7.0, DET 115/125, TOEFL 79/92, SAT EBRW 400/600, ACT Reading 20/26. An achieved IB English grade equivalent to CEFR B2+ is another route. The page has not converted TOEFL to the 2026 scale: ask international admissions about newer tests rather than assuming equivalence. SAT/ACT remain optional for admission.

deadline.value: Do not rely on one deadline: the international page lists ED/EA I November 15, EA II December 15 and RD January 15, while https://earlham.edu/admissions/how-to-apply/ lists November 1, December 1 and February 1 under a 2027–28 heading and explicitly includes international first-year applicants. Different cycle labels and the undated international page prevent confirmation of the 2026–27 schedule. Obtain the intended entry-year deadlines from international admissions.
